exposure: Mode of delivery (Cesarean section, elective Cesarean section, emergency Cesarean section, vaginal delivery)
cohort: 638 mother-infant pairs from the MAASTHI cohort 2016-2019
finding: Elective cesarean section was associated with higher BMI z-score at 1 year of age and a higher risk of being overweight compared to vaginal delivery, while emergency cesarean section showed no such association.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was associated with higher BMI z-score at 1 year of age and a higher risk of being overweight compared to vaginal delivery, while emergency cesarean section showed no such association.
